title: Set up two-photon variables
description: Adds the data variables the ophys methods read and write, for an entity type, in a data location: .npy arrays and a .json ROI file in a subfolder of each entity's folder. With rawFilePattern, TwoPhotonSeries_Original reads the raw recording through that file pattern. Variables that exist are left alone. Also adds the ophys.imaging, ophys.image_stats, ophys.fov_position and ophys.fov_region columns to the entity type, and ophys.cranial_window and ophys.injection to the subject entity type.

rawFilePattern.title: Raw file pattern
rawFilePattern.description: Name of the DSM file pattern that finds the recording. Leave empty to not add TwoPhotonSeries_Original.

subjectType.title: Subject entity type
subjectType.description: Gets the cranial window and injection columns, when the project has it

addColumns.title: Add the imaging, image statistics and FOV columns
